candidates.purpose: Establish a baseline reference fit with no features, to contextualize any improvement from ridge candidates.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: provides a simple baseline against which ridge fits may show relative improvement in fit quality.

candidates.purpose: Low-regularization, coarse feature grid, half fidelity to probe underfitting/overfitting balance cheaply.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: weak regularization with coarse grid may capture broad structure at low cost.

candidates.purpose: Moderate regularization, coarse grid, half fidelity as a balanced low-cost candidate.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: moderate regularization may yield stable fit quality at reduced compute.

candidates.purpose: Strong regularization, coarse grid, half fidelity to test bias-heavy regime cheaply.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: strong regularization may reduce variance at the cost of bias.

candidates.purpose: Low regularization with finer feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: finer grid may capture more structure while low alpha limits shrinkage.

candidates.purpose: Moderate regularization with finer feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: balanced shrinkage with finer grid may improve fit quality.

candidates.purpose: Strong regularization with finer feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: strong shrinkage on finer grid may stabilize estimates.

candidates.purpose: Low regularization, coarse grid, full fidelity for higher-precision comparison.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: full fidelity may reveal whether coarse-grid low-alpha fit improves with more data.

candidates.purpose: Moderate regularization, coarse grid, full fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: full-fidelity moderate fit may serve as a robust reference.

candidates.purpose: Strong regularization, coarse grid, full fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: full-fidelity strong shrinkage may reduce overfitting.

candidates.purpose: Low regularization, finer grid, full fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: finer grid with full fidelity and low shrinkage may capture detailed structure.

candidates.purpose: Moderate regularization, finer grid, full fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: balanced full-fidelity fit may yield strong quality.

candidates.purpose: Strong regularization, finer grid, full fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: full-fidelity strong shrinkage on finer grid may be stable but biased.
